account_move.cancel.description.description: Description of the dialog that cancels the move. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.closure.move.description: Link in the notice of the server's closure to the page that moves the account.

account_move.move.confirm.cancel.description: Button in the dialog that closes it without moving the account.

account_move.move.confirm.description.defaultMessage: 请输入密码以确认。你的关注者将改为关注 {handle}，此账号会显示已迁移。30 天内无法再次迁移。

account_move.move.password.field.description: Label of the password field in the dialog that moves the account.

account_move.move.target.description.description: Help text of the field for the account to move to.

account_move.move.target.field.description: Label of the field for the account to move to.

account_move.move.target.required.description: Error of the field for the account to move to when it is empty.

account_move.move.target.submit.description: Button that looks up the account to move to and opens the confirmation.

account_move.move.title.description: Heading and menu entry of the settings page that moves the account to another account.

account_move.move.wrong_password.description: Error in the dialog that moves the account when the password is wrong.

account_move.moved.description.description: Explains the state of an account that has moved. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.moved.title.description: Heading of the section of the move page for an account that has moved.

account_move.aliases.count.description: Read for the count beside the heading of the list of aliases. {count} is the number of aliases.
